name: IP Newsletters for Mailchimp
author: johnlaliberte2

sections.description:
Creates a custom post type that allows WordPress content to populate the body of emails sent through a user’s Mailchimp account utilizing their developer api. This plugin is software as a service. It provides the integration with the paid third party service Mailchimp.

Features

  • Basic Editorial Template populated by posts
  • HTML import feature
  • optional advertisements
  • optional link encoding
  • html preview
  • api integration to send test emails and stage or schedule future mailings
  • existing mailing cancellation feature

sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard

  1. Visit Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for “IP Newsletters for Mailchimp”
  3. Activate Advanced Custom Fields from your Plugins page
  4. Click Settings > IP Newsletters for Mailchimp
  5. Read the documentation to get started
sections.faq: -where do I find the ids of my Mailchimp Lists? Answer: Go to the plugin’s WordPress options page (/wp-admin/options-general.php?page=ipmcn). Click on Submit after Issue api call to return available lists.
